title: Endpoint DLP for Windows — Microsoft Purview
author_notes: Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal evolves — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets. No client names.
hook: Control data on Windows endpoints in Microsoft Purview
problem: Data walks out via USB, print, clipboard, and cloud upload. Left unaddressed, this is a compliance gap and a data-risk exposure. This solution delivers it end to end in Microsoft Purview: Windows Endpoint DLP onboarding + policies for USB, print, clipboard, network share, and cloud egress — configured, piloted in simulation/test where applicable, validated, and operable — so the capability is in place and defensible.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what this delivers, how it works in Purview, and the Assess→Design→Configure→Pilot(simulate)→Validate→Expand model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Purview/compliance licensing, least-privilege roles, in-scope data, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — configure Windows Endpoint DLP onboarding + policies for USB, print, clipboard, network share, and cloud egress; pilot in simulation/test first, validate, then enforce/expand — each policy/label/object named, with pass/fail gates + rollback.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation (simulation/-WhatIf first), Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — Security & Compliance PowerShell / Microsoft Graph (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Testing/validation gates + Best Practices; regulatory/records/legal determinations deferred to the relevant governance functions.
short: Control data on Windows endpoints in Microsoft Purview — Windows Endpoint DLP onboarding + policies for USB, print, clipboard, network share, and cloud egress, piloted and validated. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
